title: Maps

exercises.title: Create Map
exercises.description: Create a map ages with keys "Alice" (25), "Bob" (30). Print the map.

exercises.title: Map Lookup
exercises.description: Create map scores := map[string]int{"Math": 95, "Physics": 88}. Look up "Math" and print the score.

exercises.title: Add to Map
exercises.description: Create empty map names := make(map[string]string). Add entries: "1" -> "One", "2" -> "Two". Print map.
exercises.solution:
package main

import "fmt"

func main() {
    names := make(map[string]string)
    names["1"] = "One"
    names["2"] = "Two"
    fmt.Println(names)
}

exercises.title: Delete from Map
exercises.description: Create map data := map[string]int{"a": 1, "b": 2, "c": 3}. Delete "b", then print the map.

exercises.title: Check Key Existence
exercises.description: Create map inventory := map[string]int{"apples": 5, "oranges": 3}. Check if "bananas" exists and print exists or not found.

exercises.title: Map Length
exercises.description: Create map counts := map[string]int{"one": 1, "two": 2, "three": 3}. Print the number of entries using len().
hints: Use len(counts) to get the number of key-value pairs

exercises.title: Iterate Map
exercises.description: Create map grades := map[string]int{"A": 90, "B": 80, "C": 70}. Print each key-value pair.
hints: Use for key, value := range grades
